races.paceDynamic: Escape Plan will take the lead unchallenged with no other confirmed front runners in this field. The prominent runners Eightthreeone, Viking Glory, and Forever Glamorous will track behind but none are aggressive pace pressers, allowing Escape Plan to dictate comfortable fractions. With nine hold-up horses including Adalida, Madman, and Nebbia packed behind a sedate pace, this sets up a furious sprint finish over the final two furlongs. This race shape strongly favors hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, as they'll benefit from the slow early pace and have plenty to aim at.

scenarios.trigger: If Escape Plan is allowed to coast through easy fractions unchallenged
scenarios.body: The hold-up brigade gets perfect conditions with a moderate gallop setting up their finishing kicks. Horses like Adalida and Madman can unleash devastating late runs from off the pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Escapes
scenarios.trigger: If Escape Plan gets away with very soft fractions and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The leader gets first run on tired legs behind and holds off the late charge. Prominent runners who can stay close enough get involved in the finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Cooker
scenarios.trigger: If Viking Glory or Eightthreeone decide to press Escape Plan early
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and favors horses that can race handily without being too far back. Mid-division runners benefit from the stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If the pace completely falls apart with multiple horses going too fast or too slow
scenarios.body: Form and class become more important than running style in a tactically muddled race. The most talented horses find a way regardless of position.

races.paceDynamic: The Anthony Gover stands alone as the confirmed front-runner, likely to dictate terms unopposed in the early stages and set a comfortable tempo. Behind him, six runners (Decade Of Time, Heraldry, Mostaan, Windbreaker, Symphony's Song, Eagles Attire, Big Eagle) will create a congested prominent pack, leading to inevitable traffic problems and pace pressure from 3f out. The two unknowns Kahin and Turret add volatility - if either shows early pace, it transforms the complexion entirely. This race shape heavily favours hold-up horses like Bemersyde and Thomas Picton who can avoid the midrace squeeze and benefit from the strong pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Anthony Gover Dictates
scenarios.trigger: If The Anthony Gover gets an uncontested lead and the prominent pack gets tangled up
scenarios.body: The leader sets fractions to suit while the traffic chaos behind allows patient hold-up horses to sweep past tired leaders. Bemersyde and Thomas Picton can capitalise on the pace collapse from their patient positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Newcomer Intervention
scenarios.trigger: If Kahin or Turret shows early pace to challenge The Anthony Gover
scenarios.body: This creates genuine pace pressure from the start, setting up a true staying test that suits horses with proven stamina. The Gosden-trained Heraldry thrives in strongly-run races while Big Eagle's recent form suggests stamina.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the six prominent runners create early pressure amongst themselves while Anthony Gover escapes
scenarios.body: The midfield congestion becomes severe with multiple horses vying for the same tactical position. Late runners can exploit the pace but need luck in running to find gaps when it matters.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge Anthony Gover from the start creating genuine early pace
scenarios.body: This becomes a true test of stamina where class and experience matter most. The higher-rated newcomers and battle-hardened horses separate from the struggling field.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Kahin or Turret showing early pace as this completely transforms the race from comfortable tempo to genuine stamina test

This sustainable pace scenario strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and have something left for the finish, rather than hold-up horses who need a stronger tempo to set up their kicks.

scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates

scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the leader to control completely and see off all challengers. Jason Watson can dictate ideal fractions for a pillar-to-post success.

The large field of hold-up horses including Expert Agent, Amazonian Dream, Jenever, Strike, and Seraphim Angel will be bunched behind, setting up a cavalry charge finish. scenarios.label: D

races.paceDynamic: Overbudget, Blue Deveron, Queen Sana and Mehmas Engine will create a ferocious early gallop in this 5f sprint with four confirmed front-runners all vying for the lead. This breakneck pace will inevitably set up the race for closers, as the leaders burn each other off in a suicide mission up front. The genuine hold-up horses Filly Foden and Stock Market will have their chance to pick up the pieces, while prominent runners like Staniel Cay may find the perfect stalking position. This race shape strongly favours hold-up performers and those with finishing kicks over pure speed horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Burn Each Other
scenarios.trigger: If the four front-runners go too fast early and collapse
scenarios.body: The pace will be unsustainable with Overbudget, Blue Deveron, Queen Sana and Mehmas Engine all committed to the lead, creating perfect conditions for closers to sweep past tired leaders in the final furlong. Hold-up specialists will benefit most from this pace meltdown.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one horse finds the perfect stalking position behind the speed duel
scenarios.body: A prominent runner will track the early leaders at a sensible distance before launching a well-timed challenge when the pace-setters weaken. This tactical approach often proves decisive in sprints with heavy early pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Leader Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one front-runner gets an easy lead and controls the tempo
scenarios.body: Queen Sana or Blue Deveron could steal a march if the others are slow to break, allowing them to dictate terms and have enough left for the finish. Recent form suggests Queen Sana has the class edge among the speed horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is so fierce that outsiders benefit from the carnage
scenarios.body: The four leaders could go so fast that even the moderate hold-up horses struggle to close the gap, allowing a bigger-priced runner to emerge from the wreckage. This would require an exceptionally hot pace from the start.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Overbudget to be caught three wide early as Tom Marquand may struggle to find cover with so many other front-runners committed
Monitor Blue Deveron's jumping from the stalls as any slow start could be fatal in this competitive sprint with his need to lead
Keep an eye on Filly Foden's position turning for home as she needs to be within striking distance to capitalize on the expected pace collapse
Watch Queen Sana's early sectionals as she cannot afford to get drawn into a speed duel with three other confirmed leaders
Observe Staniel Cay's tactical positioning as Rowan Scott will need to judge the pace perfectly to deliver his challenge at the right moment
